saved_bank_templates.scope: All eight pinned V4X saved TDB/TMM directories, checked with two readers. Does not cover transient runtime additions, auxiliary databases, other banks or the template-building capabilities of original authoring software.

native_selector.scope: Owned finite timbre-axis values: empty/single/multiple/duplicate/near-epsilon groups, all three axes, interpolation and clamping. It establishes linear leaf selection, not acoustic synthesis, VQM phase production or actual Editor reachability. Original V4X saved TMM arrays are independently empty.

conclusion: The timbre-model getter does feed a linear template selector. All pinned V4X saved TMM axis groups are empty, so they provide no saved template Frame input to this route. This route cannot by itself explain the observed VQMp bit17 production or prove original units.
